startup_matched_control.scope: One paired local run: same four-session adaptive manual profile, null encryption, 100 Mbit/s, 80 ms RTT. Not a statistical or universal performance guarantee.

startup_physical_bulk.scope: Six simultaneous physical routes, sixteen TCP streams per route, thirty measured seconds after five-second warmup. Directions run separately; actual receiver payload, no per-backend 1Gbit/s qualification.

user_capacity_clarification: User clarified that 1 Gbit/s was an estimate of unknown total physical link capacity, not an acceptance target. Final selection compares functional reliability/resource/load evidence and keeps the better measured adaptive four-carrier profile; no per-host speed guarantee is inferred.

startup_mixed_load.scope: 12000 native TCP forwards retained and every connection reverified; 3072 authenticated HTTP/1 workers, 16KiB HTTPS replies, 2s pause, 60s simultaneous application workload, no retries. Each hold remained 120s after ramp.
startup_mixed_load.backend_monitor_limits: All three 65-second backend SSH monitor commands returned exit -1; client monitors succeeded. Peak backend resource use during this run is not established. A short controlled native request load follows to separate the external/Xray path.

startup_native_controls.scope: 3072 request workers, 2s pause, 30 seconds; owned backend-local HTTP target, no Xray/external site. HTTP/1 connections can be reused between workers; successful worker count is not simultaneous socket count. Held-forward proof is the separate mixed test.

final_release_decision.why: All local link functional regressions and held-forward integrity gates passed; complete six-path bulk results exceeded earlier static-profile measurements. Comparison is between full profiles, not a single isolated knob. Same-size native traffic was responsive.
